summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K announcing a third tranche of its share buyback program to reduce share capital. The tranche has a maximum aggregate amount of EUR 1.46 billion and a maximum of 429,552,243 shares. Execution starts 6 May 2026, ends between 2 July and 3 August 2026 (or earlier if limits reached). Shares will be purchased on the Spanish Continuous Market and three other trading venues, managed independently by Citigroup Global Markets Europe AG. Program is under EU Market Abuse Regulation; minimum 500,000 shares per trading day. What to watch: pace of buyback, suspension triggers, and eventual capital reduction impact.
